title: Where Research Ideation Begins: Forward-Citation Supervision for Actionable Limitation Generation
title_zh: 研究构想始于何处：面向可操作局限性生成的前向引用监督

paragraphs.en: Automated research ideation has advanced rapidly, with multi-agent workflows that generate whole research ideas end to end. These frameworks leave largely unexamined the step that seeds a good idea: identifying an actionable limitation from literature. In this paper, we focus on this first step in the research ideation pipeline. Starting from a pilot study, we find that as large language models (LLMs) scale from 0.6B to 32B parameters, they become far better at recognizing which limitation later work addressed, but no better at generating one, suggesting that the bottleneck lies in the supervision signal rather than model capacity. We therefore construct ActLim-Bench from forward citations, yielding 18,279 evidence-linked supervision triples with human verification. On this signal, we propose a three-stage post-training pipeline: supervised fine-tuning, verifier-filtered rejection-sampling fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning with the verifier as an online dense reward. Experimental results show that our method achieves the highest recall score compared to existing methods among all frontier models. We further show that our generated limitations are preferred in 64.9% of non-tied human comparisons and improve downstream ideation systems. We will release our data and code upon publication.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化研究创意生成已迅速发展，出现了能够端到端生成完整研究创意的多智能体工作流。 这些框架大多忽略了孕育好创意的关键步骤：从文献中识别出可操作的局限性。 本文聚焦于研究创意生成流程中的这第一步。 从一项初步研究出发，我们发现当大语言模型（LLM）的参数规模从 0.6B 扩展到 32B 时，它们识别后续工作解决了哪个局限性的能力大幅提升，但生成这种局限性的能力却毫无改善，这表明瓶颈在于监督信号而非模型容量。 为此，我们基于前向引用构建了 ActLim-Bench，产出了 18,279 条经人工验证的、有证据支撑的监督三元组。 基于这一信号，我们提出一个三阶段后训练流程：监督微调、经验证器筛选的拒绝采样微调，以及以验证器作为在线稠密奖励的强化学习。 实验结果表明，在所有前沿模型中，与现有方法相比，我们的方法取得了最高的召回率得分。 我们进一步表明，在非平局的人工比较中，我们生成的局限性有 64.9% 的比例更受青睐，并且能提升下游创意生成系统的表现。 我们将在论文发表后公开数据与代码。

paragraphs.en: The rapid progress of LLMs has sparked growing interest in automated research ideation. Existing multi-agent frameworks can autonomously generate end-to-end research ideas, from literature analysis to proposal generation ( Wang et al. 2024 ; Baek et al. 2025 ; Lu et al. 2024 ) . Despite these advances, one fundamental step remains largely overlooked: identifying limitations from existing literature that can serve as the foundation for novel research ideas.
paragraphs.zh: 大语言模型的快速发展引发了人们对自动化研究创意生成的日益浓厚的兴趣。 现有的多智能体框架能够自主生成端到端的研究创意，从文献分析到研究提案生成（Wang et al. 2024；Baek et al. 2025；Lu et al. 2024）。 尽管取得了这些进展，一个基础性的步骤仍在很大程度上被忽视：从现有文献中识别可用于作为新颖研究创意基础的局限性。

paragraphs.en: Therefore, as illustrated at the top of Figure 1 , we focus on the first stage of the research ideation pipeline: identifying a source-supported limitation of given scientific publication that can motivate concrete follow-up work. We call this actionable limitation generation . The task is narrower than peer review and more inspectable than end-to-end ideation, reducing error propagation in later stages.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，如图 1 顶部所示，我们关注研究构思流程的第一个阶段：识别给定科学论文中能启发具体后续工作的、有文献依据的局限性。 我们将这一任务称为可行动局限性生成。 该任务比同行评审更窄，比端到端构思更易检验，从而减少了后续阶段中的误差传播。

paragraphs.en: The central challenge is supervision. Existing limitation benchmarks draw from author-written sections, reviewer critiques, or controlled synthetic perturbations ( Faizullah et al. 2024 ; Al Azher et al. 2025b ; Xu et al. 2025 ) . LimAgents adds citation context but still derives reference limitations from author statements and OpenReview comments ( Al Azher et al. 2025a ) . Concurrent work uses future publications to evaluate complete proposals or models idea evolution over citation graphs ( Jiang 2026 ; Wang et al. 2026 ; Gao et al. 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 核心挑战在于监督。 现有的局限性基准取自作者撰写的章节、审稿人的批评意见，或受控的合成扰动（Faizullah 等，2024；Al Azher 等，2025b；Xu 等，2025）。 LimAgents 增加了引用上下文，但仍然从作者陈述和 OpenReview 评论中推导参考文献的局限性（Al Azher 等，2025a）。 同期工作利用未来发表的文献来评估完整的提案，或在引用图上对观点演化进行建模（Jiang，2026；Wang 等，2026；Gao 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: These data sources and attempts capture what authors disclose or reviewers criticize, but provide limited evidence about which shortcomings later become productive starting points for research. Nor does model scale resolve this gap. In a controlled study, larger models become better at selecting a future-pursued limitation from candidates, while source-only generation does not improve consistently. This judgment–generation asymmetry suggests that models can increasingly recognize useful shortcomings when shown them, yet still lack a direct target for producing them.
paragraphs.zh: 这些数据来源与研究尝试捕捉的是作者披露的内容或审稿人批评的意见，但对于哪些不足后来会成为卓有成效的研究起点，它们提供的证据有限。 模型规模的扩大也无法填补这一空白。 在一项受控研究中，更大的模型在从候选项中选出未来会被追求的不足之处方面表现更好，而仅基于来源的生成能力并未持续提升。 这种判断与生成之间的不对称性表明，模型在被展示有用不足之处时，越来越能够识别它们，但在自主生成这些不足之处时仍缺乏直接的切入点。

paragraphs.en: Future citations provide that target. Later citing papers reveal which limitations they adopted as motivation and attempted to address. This turns a subjective judgment into an auditable supervision signal. As shown in Figure 2 , we construct ActLim-Bench by linking each source-supported limitation to the later citing work that takes it up. The benchmark contains 18,279 evidence-linked instances, with supporting spans retained from both the source and citing papers.

paragraphs.en: We then use the same verified supervision signal in three training stages. Verified limitations first provide direct demonstrations; the verifier then selects useful model-generated variants; finally, a set-level reward optimizes match quality, coverage, redundancy, and format across the complete three-item response. The resulting 8B generator, ActLim-8B, requires only the source paper at inference time.
paragraphs.zh: 然后，我们在三个训练阶段中使用相同的经过验证的监督信号。 经过验证的局限性首先提供直接示范；随后由验证器挑选有用的模型生成变体；最后，集合级别的奖励在整个三项完整回答上优化匹配质量、覆盖度、冗余度和格式。 所得到的8B生成器ActLim-8B在推理时仅需要源论文。

paragraphs.en: Experimental results show that ActLim-8B reaches a graded recall of 0.452 on the temporally held-out NLP test set, compared with 0.262 for the strongest zero-shot baseline, and is preferred in blind human evaluation. With NLP-only training, it transfers to Computer Vision at 0.314 versus 0.252. Its limitations also improve the retrospective alignment of ideas from a fixed proposer from 0.302 to 0.480.
paragraphs.zh: 实验结果表明，ActLim-8B 在时间外推的 NLP 测试集上达到 0.452 的分级召回率，而最强的零样本基线仅为 0.262，并且在盲评人类评估中更受青睐。 仅用 NLP 训练时，它可迁移到计算机视觉领域，达到 0.314，相比之下为 0.252。 其局限性还将来自固定提出者的想法的回顾性一致性从 0.302 提升到 0.480。

paragraphs.en: In summary, our contributions are threefold: (1) We introduce forward-citation supervision for actionable limitation generation and present ActLim-Bench , an auditable benchmark of 18,279 evidence-linked instances with high annotation quality; (2) We develop a three-stage training framework that exploits the same verified signal for supervision, synthetic data filtering, and reward optimization, yielding ActLim-8B, which requires only the source paper at inference time; (3) Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our method through both automatic and human evaluations across two domains.
paragraphs.zh: 综上所述，我们的贡献有三方面：(1) 我们引入前向引用监督用于可操作局限性生成，并提出 ActLim-Bench，这是一个包含 18,279 条证据关联实例的可审计基准，具有高质量的标注；(2) 我们开发了一个三阶段训练框架，利用同一经验证的信号进行监督、合成数据过滤和奖励优化，得到 ActLim-8B，在推理时仅需源论文；(3) 大量实验通过两个领域的自动评估和人工评估证明了我们方法的有效性。

paragraphs.en: Automated scientific feedback includes full-review generation and reviewer-assistance systems ( Yuan and Liu 2022 ; Zhou et al. 2024 ; Zhu et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2026 ; Biswas et al. 2026 ; Idahl and Ahmadi 2025 ; Zeng et al. 2025 ) . These systems assess broad dimensions such as correctness, novelty, clarity, and significance, whereas limitation generation isolates paper shortcomings. Literature-review agents instead synthesize evidence across collections of papers ( Zhang et al. 2025 ; Go et al. 2026 ) . LimGen learns from author-written limitation sections ( Faizullah et al. 2024 ) ; BAGELS combines venue limitations and external reviews with retrieval ( Al Azher et al. 2025b ) ; LimitGen adds a limitation taxonomy, controlled perturbations, and human-written targets ( Xu et al. 2025 ) ; and LimAgents uses author statements, OpenReview comments, and citation context ( Al Azher et al. 2025a ) . Our target is different: each instance links a source paper to a source-supported limitation and to later citing work that adopts the limitation as motivation and attempts to address it.
paragraphs.zh: 自动化科学反馈包括完整评审生成和审稿人辅助系统（Yuan and Liu 2022；Zhou et al. 2024；Zhu et al. 2025；Li et al. 2026；Biswas et al. 2026；Idahl and Ahmadi 2025；Zeng et al. 2025）。 这些系统评估正确性、新颖性、清晰度和重要性等广泛维度，而局限性生成则聚焦于孤立出论文的不足之处。 文献综述智能体则改为对论文集合中的证据进行综合（Zhang et al. 2025；Go et al. 2026）。 LimGen 从作者撰写的局限性章节中学习（Faizullah et al. 2024）；BAGELS 将会议论文的局限性和外部评审与检索相结合（Al Azher et al. 2025b）；LimitGen 增加了局限性分类体系、受控扰动和人工撰写的目标（Xu et al. 2025）；LimAgents 则利用作者陈述、OpenReview 评论和引用上下文（Al Azher et al. 2025a）。 我们的目标有所不同：每个实例将一篇源论文与一个由该论文支持的局限性，以及后续引用该局限性作为研究动机并试图解决它的引用工作联系起来。

sents.en: Our target is different: each instance links a source paper to a source-supported limitation and to later citing work that adopts the limitation as motivation and attempts to address it.
sents.zh: 我们的目标有所不同：每个实例将一篇源论文与一个由该论文支持的局限性，以及后续引用该局限性作为研究动机并试图解决它的引用工作联系起来。

paragraphs.en: Literature-grounded systems generate hypotheses, research problems, methods, experiments, or complete proposals using retrieval, scholarly graphs, critique, and multi-agent refinement ( Wang et al. 2024 ; Yang et al. 2024 ; Baek et al. 2025 ; Li et al. 2025 ; Lu et al. 2024 ) . Dedicated benchmarks assess research-ideation and scientific-discovery capability ( Qiu et al. 2025 ; Liu et al. 2026 ; Lou et al. 2025 ) . Human studies report strong proposal-stage judgments for LLM-generated ideas, while execution-based evaluation shows that such judgments do not straightforwardly predict completed research outcomes ( Si et al. 2025a ; Si et al. 2026 ) . Recent work uses held-out future literature to evaluate proposals or supervise research-idea generation ( Jiang 2026 ; Wang et al. 2026 ; Gao et al. 2026 ) . We operate at a finer, independently inspectable granularity: the specific shortcoming in a given paper that later work takes up as motivation.
paragraphs.zh: 基于文献的系统利用检索、学术图谱、批判性审查与多智能体精炼来生成假设、研究问题、方法、实验或完整的研究提案（Wang et al. 2024；Yang et al. 2024；Baek et al. 2025；Li et al. 2025；Lu et al. 2024）。 专门的基准测试用于评估研究创意构思与科学发现能力（Qiu et al. 2025；Liu et al. 2026；Lou et al. 2025）。 人类评估研究报告称，对大语言模型生成的想法在提案阶段获得了较高的评判，而基于执行效果的评估表明，这些评判并不能直接预测最终完成的研究成果（Si et al. 2025a；Si et al. 2026）。 近期的工作利用留出的未来文献来评估研究提案或监督研究想法的生成（Jiang 2026；Wang et al. 2026；Gao et al. 2026）。 我们在一个更精细、可独立审查的粒度上开展工作：即某篇论文中后来被后续工作作为研究动机的具体缺陷。

paragraphs.en: Different citing papers may pursue semantically equivalent limitations of the same source paper. We merge these into a canonical paper-level target ℓ ∈ 𝒢 P \ell\in\mathcal{G}_{P} while retaining every supporting citing paper and span. Splits are built at the source-paper level, with source and citing papers disjoint across splits. To limit version and near-duplicate leakage we collapse arXiv and conference versions, normalize metadata, remove highly similar abstracts, audit citation-graph overlap, and inspect similar limitation paraphrases across splits. All prompts, extraction rules, and verification thresholds were fixed before Test was finalized. A separate Computer Vision set of 2024–2025 papers is built by the identical pipeline and used only for transfer evaluation. Table 1 summarizes the dataset statistics.

paragraphs.en: Let x P x_{P} denote the visible text of a source paper P P , and let 𝒢 P \mathcal{G}_{P} denote its observed set of future-pursued limitations. Given x P x_{P} and an output number K K , the model generates 𝐘 = ( y 1 , … , y K ) ∼ p θ ( ⋅ ∣ x P , K ) \mathbf{Y}=(y_{1},\ldots,y_{K})\sim p_{\theta}(\cdot\mid x_{P},K) . Each output should identify a technically specific limitation that is consistent with the source paper and can motivate concrete follow-up work. Because 𝒢 P \mathcal{G}_{P} is recovered from later citations, it records observed future response rather than every valid limitation of P P . At inference time, the model receives only x P x_{P} and K K ; citing papers, observed targets, and verifier scores are unavailable to models.

paragraphs.en: Before presenting our method, we first conduct a pilot study to investigate how limitation discrimination and generation scale with model size (see Experiments for more details). The resulting judgment–generation asymmetry (Figure 4 ) motivates our training design. When candidate limitations are made explicit, models increasingly recognize which one later work will pursue, yet this judgment does not reliably emerge in open-ended generation. Standard post-training recipes specify how to learn from demonstrations, preferences, or rewards, but are largely agnostic to which scientific shortcomings should define those signals. For actionable limitation generation, this target is the missing ingredient. We therefore use forward-citation verification at three cumulative interfaces (see Figure 2 ) : first to define what the model should imitate, then to select which of its own generations are worth learning from, and finally to assign graded credit to a complete response.

paragraphs.en: The verifier retains the same semantics across all three stages while its training role changes. sents.en: The stages therefore ground what to generate, broaden how the target can be expressed, and coordinate multiple limitations as a set.

paragraphs.en: For comparison, we select representative open source models and agentic methods. Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al. 2025 ) provide same-family capability references for the trainable Qwen3-8B generator. Qwen-72B-Chat ( Bai et al. 2023 ) , Claude-3-Opus, Gemini-1.0-Ultra ( Gemini Team et al. 2023 ) , and GPT-4-Turbo provide additional zero-shot references. Exact API snapshots, release dates, and documented knowledge cutoffs are reported in the supplement. Prompting baselines use Qwen3-8B ( Wei et al. 2022 ; Madaan et al. 2023 ) . paragraphs.en: As shown in Table 2 , ActLim-8B reaches 0.452 GRec@3 I and 0.241 SpecRec@3 I , compared with the strongest zero-shot values of 0.262 and 0.098. The 8B model therefore gains 0.190 graded recall, more than doubles specific-level recovery, and exceeds the same-family 32B reference. paragraphs.en: The CV test set contains 1,737 source papers from CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV 2024–2025, with 3,961 evidence-linked triples and 3,562 aggregated targets. No CV data are used for training or model selection. ActLim-8B reaches 0.314 GRec@3 I , 0.062 above the strongest zero-shot system (95% CI [ 0.048 , 0.076 ] [0.048,0.076] ), and 0.116 above Qwen3-8B ( [ 0.102 , 0.130 ] [0.102,0.130] ). The Stage-1–Stage-2–Stage-3 sequence continues at 0.232, 0.279, and 0.314, showing that both verifier-guided expansion and set-level optimization transfer beyond the training domain. A separate 100-triple audit yields 0.83 joint precision (95% Wilson CI [ 0.745 , 0.891 ] [0.745,0.891] ; κ = 0.71 \kappa=0.71 ). paragraphs.en: To isolate the supervision source, we train four models on the same 1,240 papers, 2,795 examples, and approximately 2.1M target tokens, using the same recipe and three seeds. Target-length distributions are matched. Forward- citation supervision reaches 0.353 GRec@3 I , 0.117 above the strongest alternative, and 0.172 SpecRec@3 I , compared with 0.087 for controlled perturbations (Table 3 ). The benchmark evaluator gives a 0.120 gain (95% CI [ 0.101 , 0.140 ] [0.101,0.140] ). The effect is therefore not limited to broad category agreement; it is largest at the specific level that can support a concrete follow-up.
paragraphs.zh: 为了隔离监督来源，我们在相同的 1,240 篇论文、2,795 个样本和约 2.1M 目标 token 上，使用相同的方案和三个随机种子训练四个模型。 目标长度的分布是匹配的。 前向引用监督达到 0.353 GRec@3 I，比最强替代方案高 0.117，并在具体层面达到 0.172 SpecRec@3 I，而受控扰动仅为 0.087（表 3）。 基准评估器给出 0.120 的增益（95% 置信区间 [0.101, 0.140]）。 因此，这种效果并不限于宽泛的类别一致性；它在能够支持具体后续工作的具体层面最大。

paragraphs.en: We test whether improving the supplied limitation improves downstream research ideation. For each paper, the same fixed Llama-3.1-70B-Instruct model ( Grattafiori et al. 2024 ) generates one research idea under four conditions: from the paper alone, or from the paper paired with a zero-shot, ActLim-8B, or gold forward-citation limitation. paragraphs.en: In this paper, we aim to optimize current ideation system by exploring supervision signals derived from future-citation publications. We first observe a judgment–generation asymmetry: scaling up language models consistently improves limitation identification, while open-ended limitation generation benefits much less. Forward citations naturally bridge this gap by linking a source paper, a specific limitation, and subsequent work that attempts to address it, providing reliable supervision for training. Based on this insight, we construct ActLim-Bench , an auditable benchmark that captures these citation-grounded limitation links, and propose a three-stage training framework that effectively leverages this supervision. Extensive experiments show that our approach outperforms frontier models and competitive baselines, generalizes across domains, and improves downstream research ideation. While ActLim-Bench captures only limitations that are later pursued by follow-up work, it provides a practical and scalable bridge between understanding prior research and proposing future directions.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们旨在通过探索源自未来引用论文的监督信号来优化当前的构思系统。 我们首先观察到一种判断—生成不对称性：扩大语言模型规模能持续提升局限性识别能力，而开放式的局限性生成受益则少得多。 前向引用通过将源论文、具体局限性以及试图解决该局限性的后续工作联系起来，自然地弥合了这一差距，为训练提供了可靠的监督。 基于这一洞察，我们构建了 ActLim-Bench，一个可审计、能够捕捉这些基于引用的局限性关联的基准，并提出一个能有效利用这种监督的三阶段训练框架。 大量实验表明，我们的方法优于前沿模型和有竞争力的基线，能够跨领域泛化，并提升下游的研究构思。 虽然 ActLim-Bench 只捕捉了后来被后续工作跟进的局限性，但它在理解已有研究与提出未来方向之间提供了一座实用且可扩展的桥梁。

sents.en: Extensive experiments show that our approach outperforms frontier models and competitive baselines, generalizes across domains, and improves downstream research ideation.
sents.zh: 大量实验表明，我们的方法优于前沿模型和有竞争力的基线，能够跨领域泛化，并提升下游的研究构思。

sents.en: While ActLim-Bench captures only limitations that are later pursued by follow-up work, it provides a practical and scalable bridge between understanding prior research and proposing future directions.
sents.zh: 虽然 ActLim-Bench 只捕捉了后来被后续工作跟进的局限性，但它在理解已有研究与提出未来方向之间提供了一座实用且可扩展的桥梁。

paragraphs.en: Source papers are drawn from ACL, EMNLP, NAACL, EACL, COLING, and TACL between 2017 and 2025. paragraphs.en: Trainable conditions use seeds 13, 42, and 2024; paper-level scores are averaged across aligned seeds before any test, and main-table entries are the resulting means. Paired differences use 10,000 paper-level bootstrap resamples of the seed-averaged scores, reported as percentile intervals. Proportions use Wilson score intervals. The scaling analysis uses Spearman ρ \rho and OLS on log 10 \log_{10} parameter count with bootstrap intervals. Pairwise preference uses exact two-sided binomial tests with ties excluded, Holm-corrected over the four comparisons in Section F.1 . Downstream ratings use two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests over 100 paired examples.

paragraphs.en: Each source paper contributes one selection item. When a paper has more than one observed target, the positive is the target supported by the largest number of citing papers, ties broken by earliest citing-paper date. Each item pairs that positive with seven counterfactual negatives, generated by the same DeepSeek model used for construction, under an edit instruction that changes the affected component, the mechanism, or the evaluation condition while preserving surface form, then matched to the positive on category, length within ± 3 \pm 3 tokens, specificity level, lexical style, and source relevance. 4,118 generated negatives (27.9%) were discarded for failing these constraints. An ambiguity screen removes 91 of 1,512 candidate sets in which two or more candidates were accepted as facet-or-better matches to the same target, leaving 1,421; in a human audit of 200 retained sets, 194 (97%) have a unique correct answer. A candidate-only logistic classifier over BAAI/bge-m3 embeddings, which never sees the source paper and is trained and evaluated by five-fold cross-validation over the 1,421 retained sets with accuracy pooled across held-out folds, scores 0.138 0.138 [ 0.121 , 0.156 ] [0.121,0.156] , an interval containing chance, so the negatives carry no exploitable surface signal.
paragraphs.zh: 每篇源论文贡献一个选择题项。 当一篇论文具有多个被观察的目标时，正例为被最多引用论文支持的目标，平局时以最早的引用论文日期为准。 每个题项将该正例与七个反事实负例配对，负例由与构建时相同的 DeepSeek 模型生成，所用的编辑指令会改变受影响的组件、机制或评估条件，同时保持表面形式不变，然后按类别、长度（± 3 \pm 3 个词元以内）、具体性级别、词汇风格和源相关性将其与正例匹配。共有 4,118 个生成的负例（27.9%）因未满足这些约束而被丢弃。 一道歧义筛查环节从 1,512 个候选集合中移除了 91 个存在两个或更多候选被接受为对同一目标的方面级或更优匹配的集合，剩下 1,421 个；在对 200 个保留集合的人工审计中，194 个（97%）具有唯一的正确答案。 一个仅基于候选、作用于 BAAI/bge-m3 嵌入的逻辑回归分类器——它从不接触源论文，并通过对这 1,421 个保留集合进行五折交叉验证来训练和评估、准确率在各留出折上汇总——得分为 0.138 0.138 [ 0.121 , 0.156 ] [0.121,0.156]，该区间包含随机水平，因此负例不携带任何可利用的表面信号。

paragraphs.en: Table 23 follows a single source paper through the three cumulative stages. paragraphs.en: Zero-shot systems frequently return three variations on the same concern, typically evaluation breadth; the NONE 0.0 output in Table 24 is one such case, and its two companions in the same response repeat it. paragraphs.en: Three NLP PhD annotators with 3–5 years of research experience and at least two first-author publications at ACL-family venues, recruited from groups uninvolved in this work and compensated at USD 25 per hour, provided position-randomized pairwise judgments with a tie option, plus binary actionability and source-faithfulness ratings. Median time per pairwise comparison was 2.4 minutes and total annotation time was 61 hours. The study was reviewed by the institutional ethics board and determined exempt as minimal-risk research on professional judgment. Sampling: 120 comparisons per opponent drawn uniformly at random from the 1,512-paper Test split under a fixed seed and disjoint across opponents, and 150 outputs per system for absolute ratings from the same seeded pool. Each item was rated independently by all three annotators. Pairwise W/T/L outcomes use majority vote, absolute scores use majority vote per binary criterion, and for the downstream study the three ratings are averaged within each paper before the paired Wilcoxon test. Agreement is Fleiss’ κ = 0.47 \kappa=0.47 for pairwise judgments and 0.58 0.58 for the absolute rubric.
paragraphs.zh: 三名具有3至5年研究经验、并在ACL系列会议上有至少两篇一作论文的自然语言处理（NLP）方向博士标注者，从与本工作无关的研究组招募，报酬为每小时25美元，他们提供了位置随机化的成对判断（含平局选项），以及二元可操作性和来源忠实度评分。 每次成对比较的中位耗时为2.4分钟，总标注时长为61小时。 该研究经机构伦理委员会审查，被认定豁免，属于最小风险的专业判断类研究。 抽样：每个对手从固定的1,512篇论文测试集中按固定种子均匀随机抽取120次比较，且各对手之间互不重叠；每个系统从同一种子池中抽取150个输出用于绝对评分。 每个条目均由三名标注者独立评分。 成对胜负平结果采用多数投票，绝对分数对每个二元标准采用多数投票，而在下游研究中，三份评分先在每篇论文内取平均，再进行配对Wilcoxon检验。 一致性为成对判断的Fleiss' κ = 0.47 \kappa=0.47，绝对量表的为0.58 0.58。

paragraphs.en: Actionable : “Could a researcher who has read only this paper turn this statement into a concrete next experiment or system change, without first having to decide what the statement refers to?” Faithful : “Is this statement true of the paper as written, given its stated method, assumptions, and scope?” Pairwise : “Which would be more useful as the starting point for follow-up work? Prefer the one that is both faithful and actionable; if one is faithful but generic and the other specific but inaccurate, select a tie.”

paragraphs.en: You are given the abstract and introduction of a paper Q, and the title and abstract of an earlier paper P that Q cites. Identify every statement in Q that motivates Q’s own contribution by pointing to a shortcoming of P. For each, output a JSON object with fields "limitation" (one sentence, technical, no hedging) and "evidence" (the verbatim sentence from Q). Output a JSON list; output [] if there are none. Do not infer shortcomings that Q does not state.
paragraphs.zh: 给你一篇论文 Q 的摘要和引言，以及 Q 所引用的早期论文 P 的标题和摘要。 找出 Q 中所有通过指出 P 的不足来引出 Q 自身贡献的陈述。 对每一条，输出一个 JSON 对象，包含字段 "limitation"（一句话、技术性表述、不使用模糊措辞）和 "evidence"（Q 中原句的逐字引用）。 输出一个 JSON 列表；如果没有，则输出 []。 不要推断 Q 中并未陈述的不足。

sents.zh: 给你一篇论文 Q 的摘要和引言，以及 Q 所引用的早期论文 P 的标题和摘要。

sents.en: Identify every statement in Q that motivates Q’s own contribution by pointing to a shortcoming of P.

sents.zh: 不要推断 Q 中并未陈述的不足。

paragraphs.en: Judge the candidate limitation on four criteria, each strictly yes or no. ATTRIBUTION: does Q attribute this shortcoming to P, or to a named method family that explicitly includes P? CONSISTENCY: is it consistent with P’s method, assumptions, evidence, and stated scope? SPECIFICITY: does it name a concrete component, mechanism, assumption, data condition, or evaluation constraint, rather than asking for more experiments or better results? RESPONSE: does Q’s main contribution attempt to address it? Output JSON with the four booleans and the supporting span from P.
paragraphs.zh: 从四个标准判断候选局限，每个标准严格回答是或否。 归因（ATTRIBUTION）：Q 是否将该缺点归因于 P，或归因于一个明确包含 P 的已命名方法族？ 一致性（CONSISTENCY）：该判断是否与 P 的方法、假设、证据以及所声明的研究范围一致？ 具体性（SPECIFICITY）：它是否指出了某个具体的组件、机制、假设、数据条件或评估约束，而不是仅仅要求更多实验或更好的结果？ 回应（RESPONSE）：Q 的主要贡献是否试图解决该缺点？ 输出 JSON，包含这四个布尔值以及 P 中的支持性片段。

paragraphs.en: Given the source paper and a pair (prediction, target), output one of: NONE if they concern different shortcomings; CATEGORY if the broad type matches but the affected component does not; FACET if the type, the affected component, and the aspect all match; SPECIFIC if the prediction identifies the same concrete shortcoming at the granularity a follow-up would act on. Output the label only.
paragraphs.zh: 给定源论文和一对（预测，目标），输出以下之一：NONE，如果两者涉及不同的不足之处；CATEGORY，如果广义类型匹配但受影响的组件不匹配；FACET，如果类型、受影响的组件和方面都匹配；SPECIFIC，如果预测识别出了与后续行动所依据的粒度相同的具体不足。仅输出标签。

Each must be supported by the paper itself and must name a specific component, mechanism, assumption, data condition, or evaluation constraint. Do not ask for more experiments or better results in general. Output a numbered list of {N} single sentences and nothing else.

paragraphs.en: Source and citing papers are drawn from arXiv, the ACL Anthology, and the open proceedings of CVPR, ICCV, and ECCV. For sources whose licenses permit redistribution, the release contains evidence spans, canonical limitations, and paper identifiers. For non-redistributable sources, it provides the DOI, section identifier, and character offsets rather than the underlying text. No OpenReview content is included in ActLim-Bench ; the reviewer-written supervision arm of the supervision-source comparison uses public OpenReview text under its terms of use and is released as identifiers and offsets only.
paragraphs.zh: 来源论文与引用论文均取自 arXiv、ACL Anthology，以及 CVPR、ICCV 和 ECCV 的公开论文集。 对于许可证允许再分发的来源，本发布内容包含证据片段、规范化局限性描述以及论文标识符。 对于不可再分发的来源，本基准提供 DOI、章节标识符和字符偏移量，而非底层文本。 ActLim-Bench 不包含任何 OpenReview 内容；在监督来源对比中，由审稿人撰写的监督分支依据其使用条款使用公开的 OpenReview 文本，并且仅以标识符和偏移量的形式发布。

paragraphs.en: ActLim-Bench records limitations that later work in fact pursued. It is a proxy for actionability rather than a measure of scientific value: a limitation may go unpursued because of timing, resources, or shifting research priorities, and a pursued direction is not necessarily the most important shortcoming of a paper. The dataset supports research on scientific ideation and should not be used to evaluate individual papers, authors, or venues.
paragraphs.zh: ActLim-Bench 记录的是后续工作确实追随过研究的一些局限性。 它衡量的是可行动性，而非科学价值：一个局限性可能由于时机、资源或研究优先级的变化而未被追随，而一个被追随的方向也不一定是论文最重要的不足之处。 该数据集支持关于科学构思的研究，不应用于评估单篇论文、作者或发表平台。

paragraphs.en: Scoring is anchored at three points. The primary metric comes from an evaluator in a different model family that takes no part in construction, filtering, reward, or model selection. The targets are validated by the 400-triple human audit of Section A.4 , and the graded scale by the validation in Section B.4 . Blind human preference judgments (Section F.1 ) evaluate the resulting outputs with no model evaluator in the loop.
